A game that finally perfected one-handed controls, yet the content is damn near impossible to masturbate to... Also, the title is misleading, since I find it way more enjoyable with two fingers. …

Ridiculously good for its price. I've played the first one countless hours, and the second is nothing but better. Would highly recomend, its not as hard as it looks so dont let difficulty scare you, and everything is so fluid and smooth.

When a game is as simple as One Finger Death Punch any small tweak can break the system. Heres the big problem: I hate the auto combos. Too often the game takes control away to play a flashy animation. …
这游戏真的越玩越上头！左右点击攻击的操作看起来很简单，但实际玩起来非常考验反应速度和节奏感。敌人从两边不断出现，需要快速判断攻击方向，稍微慢一点就可能被打中。特别喜欢连续击倒敌人的爽快感，配合流畅的动画和音效，打起来特别有感觉。 …
打击很爽快，关卡也非常多，还好星级条件比较宽松，容易拿，不然就折磨了，总体还是更适合平板手机。7.5/10
